recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-3689; future Observation/DeviceMetric changes should be handled through newer tickets.
issue_request: FHIR-3689 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for DSTU1. It requested moving Device out of Observation.performer into a new 0..1 Observation.device that can reference Device or DeviceMetric, with guidance that further typing should use extensions and support devices should be represented through related structures or extensions.
initial_application: The issue was directly applied by b84778c4b6ad78e3dbb02fea81ec2c10467045c6, whose subject says it removed device from Obs.performer and created Obs.device for #3689. That spreadsheet-era patch added Observation.device as 0..1 Reference(Device|DeviceMetric), kept the #3689 marker, supplied the requested short/definition, and removed Device from performer. The later XML-source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried the same #3689 element and targets forward.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Observation source includes Observation.device with Device and DeviceMetric target profiles, excludes Device/DeviceMetric from Observation.performer, includes an Observation-device search parameter, and has later guidance explaining the role of subject, focus, device, and human transcription. Later related issues FHIR-33389, FHIR-40335, and FHIR-43357 are already represented on the combined branch and refine but do not reverse FHIR-3689.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current build-scoped source already satisfies FHIR-3689, and publishing duplicate commits for already-decided later related tickets would be inappropriate.
